title: Croatian Spring Pasta Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry made with zesty Croatian spring onions and delicious pasta. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped spring onions and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet or wok and stir to combine with the spring onions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the zesty (soy sauce), sesame oil, and grated ginger.
Pour the sauce over the pasta and spring onions, and stir to combine.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve hot.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
